instrument_name: NRS chapter 608 Compensation, Wages and Hours (edition incl. 2025 regular session and 36th Special Session amendments), wayback snapshot 2026-10-22
figure_or_rule_carried: Daily OT 1.5x over 8h/workday or 40h/week if paid < 1.5x min wage (4x10 by agreement); weekly OT only if >= 1.5x (608.018; exemptions incl. agricultural, sales<250k, live-in domestic by written agreement). Paid leave 0.01923 h per hour worked, employers 50+ employees in NV, usable from day 90, employer may cap use and carry-over at 40 h/benefit year, paid at current rate (salaried: 90-day average), accounting of available hours on each payday, payout on separation not required, reinstated if rehired within 90 days after involuntary separation, records 1 year, temporary/seasonal/on-call excluded, new employers exempt first 2 years (608.0197). Discharge/nonworking status: due immediately (608.020); resign: earlier of regular payday or 7 days (608.030); penalty wages continue up to 30 days (608.040). Semimonthly pay: earned before 1st due by 8 a.m. on 15th of next month; earned before 16th due by 8 a.m. last day of same month; out-of-state payroll may pay exempt/outside sales/supervisors monthly (608.060). Paydays posted; 7 days written notice of change (608.080); 7 days written notice of pay decrease (608.100). Itemized deductions list at each payment; deductions by written order of employee (608.110). Wage records per pay period (gross, deductions, net, hours per day, date of payment), furnished within 10 days of request, kept 2 years (608.115). Payment in cash or negotiable check unless employee agrees in writing to other disposition (608.120). Lodging credit max 5x min hourly wage per week; meals max 100% of min hourly wage per day (25/25/50%) by agreement, not agricultural (608.154/155). 608.250 statutory text still two-tier (11.00/12.00 from 2024-07-01), overridden by Const. art.15 s.16 as amended 2022 (see US-NVS5-002). 608.016 version effective through 2029-10-31 (2025 36th Special Session).

instrument_name: Office of the Labor Commissioner: State of Nevada Minimum Wage 2026 Annual Bulletin (posted 2026-06-29)
authority: Nevada Office of the Labor Commissioner
figure_or_rule_carried: Minimum wage 12.00 USD/hour effective 2026-07-01 for all employees regardless of health benefits offered; Ballot Question 2 (Nov 2022) eliminated the two-tier wage as of 2024-07-01. Bulletin text also says 'effective as of July 1, 2025' (same 12.00 rate since 2024-07-01). No local minimum wages located. Direct curl got a bot-check page; copy via web.archive.org id_.

instrument_name: Office of the Labor Commissioner: Daily Overtime 2026 Annual Bulletin (posted 2026-06-29)
authority: Nevada Office of the Labor Commissioner
figure_or_rule_carried: From 2026-07-01 employees earning less than 18.00 USD/hour (1.5 x 12.00) get 1.5x regular rate over 8 hours in a 24-hour period or over 40 hours in a workweek; employees above 18.00 only over 40 h/week.

instrument_name: NRS chapter 31 (garnishment of earnings), wayback snapshot 2026-10-10
figure_or_rule_carried: Creditor garnishment cap: the lesser of 18% of disposable earnings if gross weekly wage on the date of the most recent writ was 770 USD or less, 25% if above 770, or disposable earnings above 50 x federal minimum hourly wage (31.295(2)); stricter than CCPA 25%. Caps do not apply to support orders, bankruptcy orders, state/federal tax debts (31.295(3)). Support garnishment caps 50%/60% (55%/65% if arrears > 12 weeks) (31.295(4)). Gross weekly wage = YTD gross / weeks worked in the year (31.2955). Writ continues 180 days or until satisfied; garnishee fee 3 USD per pay period, max 12 USD/month, not for the first pay period (31.296).

instrument_name: NRS chapter 31A (enforcement of support obligations: withholding of income), wayback snapshot 2025-12-25
figure_or_rule_carried: Income payer withholds from the first payment within 14 days after the notice was sent and remits within 7 days after the date of payment (31A.080(1)); deducts the State Treasurer fee of 2 USD per withholding (max two times a month) and remits fees at least quarterly (31A.075, 31A.080(2)); may deduct 3 USD per withholding for its own costs (31A.090(2)); electronic transfer where NRS 353.1467 applies (50+ employees); notify on termination with last known address and new employer (31A.080(2)(c)). Child-support withholding has priority over any other proceeding against the same money; current support over other support orders (31A.160). Limits per NRS 31.295 percentages.

instrument_name: NRS chapter 612 Unemployment Compensation, wayback snapshot 2026-10-19
figure_or_rule_carried: Standard/new-employer rate 2.95% until eligible for experience rate under 612.550 (612.540). Taxable wage base = 66 2/3% of the average annual wage of the preceding calendar year, rounded to nearest 100 USD, computed on or before July 1 (612.545(1)); wages paid by the same employer for services in another state on which that state's UI contributions are required count toward the NV base (612.545(2)(b)). Career Enhancement Program 0.05% of wages, not for 5.4%-rated or reimbursing employers, kept separate from UI rates (612.606). UI wages include tips reported under 26 USC 6053(a) and non-cash remuneration at cash value; exclude employer retirement/sickness/medical/death plan payments, 401(a) trust payments, employer-paid FICA, non-cash pay to agricultural labour (612.190). Coverage: agricultural labour if 20,000 USD cash wages in a quarter or 10+ workers in 20 weeks (612.090); domestic service only if 1,000 USD cash wages in a quarter (612.095); family employment excluded (child under 18 for parent, parent/spouse) (612.105); student work-experience/financial-assistance programs excluded (612.118/119); nonprofit/religious coverage conditions (612.121); newspaper delivery minors, licensed real-estate salespersons excluded (612.130/133). Localization test 612.080.

instrument_name: NRS 606.120 (new hire report) plus DETR New Hire Reporting Information page
authority: Nevada Legislature; Nevada DETR Employment Security Division
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer reports each new hire, and each rehire after at least 60 consecutive days of separation, for whom a W-4 is required, within 20 days of hire (time prescribed by 42 USC 653a) to DETR Employment Security Division New Hire Unit; required: employee full name, address, SSN, start date, employer FEIN, name, address; optional DOB and state of hire; online portal, SFTP, fax 775-684-6379 or mail; civil penalty under 25 USD may be set by regulation (606.120(3)). NRS 606 text from 2024-02-25 snapshot (2023 edition).

instrument_name: DETR Nevada Unemployment Compensation Employer Handbook (published 9/2023): Quarterly Contribution and Wage Reports, Payment Options, ESS
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer's Quarterly Report (RPT3795) and Wage Report (NEW0098) each quarter; due (received) by the last day of the month after the quarter: Apr 30, Jul 31, Oct 31, Jan 31 (next business day if weekend/holiday; online by 5 p.m. Pacific); wages reported in the quarter paid, all gross wages including tips per employee; online in ESS (ui.nv.gov/ess) by data entry, SFTP upload in EFW2 specification, or CSV/tab-delimited file; paper forms by mail; payment by check only if under 10,000 USD per quarter, else ACH credit or debit. Employer posts the Notice to Employees (NUCS-4324). Edition 2023: re-verify against current ESS guide.

instrument_name: NV Department of Taxation: Modified Business Tax page (read 2026-11-02) and notice 'MBT Wage Comparison Resumes January 1, 2026'
article_or_section: MBT Tax Rate; About MBT; notice PDF https://tax.nv.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Modified-Business-Tax-Wage-Comparison-Resumes-January-1-2026.pdf
figure_or_rule_carried: Rates still 'current rates effective July 1, 2023' on 2026-11-02: general business 1.17% of quarterly wages above 50,000 USD; financial institutions (incl. Net Proceeds of Minerals taxpayers, MBT-Mining return) 1.554% of all wages after health deduction. Base: total gross wages and reported tips as reported to ESD on NUCS 4072, less employer-paid health benefits. Exempt: nonprofit 501(c), Indian tribes, political subdivisions, household-only employers. From 2026-01-01 the Department resumes a quarterly comparison of MBT-return wages vs ESD wages; mismatch or no return -> deficiency determination (NRS 360.300-360.400), 45 days to petition, then 10% penalty; health deduction only for employer-paid amounts. Confirms rows US-NVP7-001/US-NVP7-002 for 2026 (no change to rate).

instrument_name: NV Department of Taxation form TAX-F003 MBT Return - General Business (V2026.1, 12/2/2025-current) with instructions
figure_or_rule_carried: Quarterly return, due last day of the month following the quarter, filed on My Nevada Tax (MyNVTax.nv.gov) or by mail. Line 1 total gross wages incl. tips (must match ESD); line 2 employer-paid health deduction; line 4 offset carried forward (health costs exceeding wages); line 7 threshold 50,000; line 9 tax = line 8 x .0117; line 10 Commerce Tax credit 50% of prior-year Commerce Tax, usable in the next 4 quarters; line 11 other approved credits; late penalty by days late per NAC 360.395, max 10%. Return must be filed even when no tax is due. PDF (6.58 MB) discarded after text extraction; sha256 in the local text file header.

instrument_name: NRS chapter 363B Modified Business Tax on general businesses (wayback snapshot 2026-06-08)
figure_or_rule_carried: Statutory rate 1.475% of quarterly wages (NRS 612.190 definition) above 50,000 USD 'except as otherwise provided in NRS 360.203' (the reduction mechanism giving 1.17% from 2023-07-01); tax must not be deducted from employee wages (363B.110(2)(b)); return and payment by the last day of the month after each quarter (363B.110(3)); Commerce Tax credit 50% (363B.110(4)); scholarship-donation credit (363B.110(5)); deduction of employer-paid health insurance/self-insured ERISA plan costs/Taft-Hartley, excluding workers' comp medical and employee-paid amounts (363B.115).

instrument_name: NV Department of Taxation: MBT rate reduction calculation under NRS 360.203 (calculation dated 2022-09-30, published 2024-03), quoting NRS 360.203
figure_or_rule_carried: September 2022 calculation: MBT-NFI rate 1.378% -> 1.169% computed, set at 1.170% under NRS 360.203(4); MBT-FI & Mining 1.853% -> 1.553% computed, set at 1.554% for proportional consistency; effective 2023-07-01. NRS 360.203(4): once the 363B.110 rate is 1.17%, the Department no longer makes the biennial (even-year, by Sept 30) determination and the rates must not be further adjusted. Consequence: no 2026 determination and no MBT rate change on 2027-07-01 under 360.203; 1.17% / 1.554% stand until the Legislature changes the statute.

instrument_name: Constitution of the State of Nevada, Art. 15 Sec. 16 (Payment of minimum compensation to employees), as amended by Ballot Question 2 (2022), wayback snapshot 2026-10-25
figure_or_rule_carried: From 2024-07-01 every employer pays not less than 12.00 USD per hour worked; if the federal minimum wage exceeds 12.00 the federal rate applies; Legislature may set a higher rate by law; tips may not be credited against the minimum wage (no tip credit); waivable only explicitly in a bona fide CBA; 'employee' excludes under-18s employed by a nonprofit for after-school or summer employment and trainees for up to 90 days. No automatic annual indexation in the text.

instrument_name: Constitution of the State of Nevada, Art. 10 Sec. 1(9) (no income tax on wages or personal income of natural persons), wayback snapshot 2026-10-25
figure_or_rule_carried: 'No income tax shall be levied upon the wages or personal income of natural persons.' Constitutional basis for: no state income tax withholding, no state W-4, no state W-2 filing, no local wage tax, no reciprocity. Complements US-NV-001 (Dept of Taxation page).

instrument_name: NRS chapter 609 Employment of children (wayback snapshot 2025-12-19)
figure_or_rule_carried: Child under 16: max 48 hours a week and 8 hours a day (except motion-picture performer or farm work) (609.240); under 14 restrictions (609.245/250); no work-permit rule affecting payroll located. Minimum wage applies to minors (Const. art.15 s.16), except under-18s employed by a nonprofit for after-school or summer work.

instrument_name: NRS 613.600-613.630 Domestic Workers' Bill of Rights (NRS chapter 613, wayback snapshot 2026-10-22)
figure_or_rule_carried: Domestic worker: written employment agreement at hire (rate, OT, frequency and method of pay, deductions; explained in a language the worker understands); paid at least the constitutional minimum wage for all working time; daily OT 1.5x over 8 h in a workday if paid < 1.5x minimum (subject to 608.018); 40+ h/week workers get 24 consecutive hours rest a week and 48 a month, work on rest day paid; meal deduction only with written consent and within NRS 608.155 limits; lodging deduction only with consent, not if residence is required, within 608.154; no deduction for required uniforms.

instrument_name: NRS chapter 603A Security and privacy of personal information (wayback snapshot 2026-11-01)
figure_or_rule_carried: Personal information = name + SSN, driver licence/ID number, financial account number with code, medical/health insurance ID, or online credentials, when not encrypted; last four digits of SSN excluded (603A.040). Businesses maintaining personal information keep reasonable security measures (603A.210), encrypt in transfer outside a secure system (603A.215), notify breaches (603A.220), destroy records by reasonable measures (603A.200). No Nevada statute located requiring SSN truncation on the pay statement (608.110/115 silent; 603A does not regulate pay statements).

instrument_name: Office of the Labor Commissioner: Rules to be Observed by Employers (required posting; summary of NRS/NAC 607-608, revised 1/16/2025, file dated 05.08.2025)
authority: Nevada Office of the Labor Commissioner
figure_or_rule_carried: Meal period 30 min uninterrupted for 8 continuous hours; paid rest period 10 min per 4 hours or major fraction; wages semimonthly or more often; wage records list deductions agreed in writing for a specific purpose, pay period and amount; deductions only for the employee's benefit and authorised by written order; tips belong to employees (pooling among employees allowed); uniforms distinctive in style furnished and specially-cleaned free; 2-4 hours paid leave for COVID-19 vaccination (SB 209, 2021); restates 12.00 minimum (no tip credit), daily OT, final pay, paid leave 608.0197. Summary, not legal advice: statute rows govern. Direct curl got a bot-check page; copy via web.archive.org id_.
